page_summary:
The Jungle People is the canonical works record for PKD's short-story collection. It preserves a single archive manifestation and gives the work a stable bibliographic home. The preserved item here is The Jungle People (Berkeley Daily Gazette, February 17, 1942) (1942). The archive copy runs 2 pages.

Archive summary: A 2-page scanned PDF of 'The Jungle People,' an early piece by Philip K.
